records.title: The First Cry
records.setup: Guided six-seat mystery with two to six humans and bot fill. Fewer traps, explicit notebook prompts, and a limited room route.
records.win: Correctly identify suspect, weapon, and room.
records.loss: All active heroes are eliminated or tutorial timer expires.

records.title: Storm-Bound Murder
records.setup: Full sixteen-room keep, standard monster and trap density, private evidence with voluntary sharing, and team accusation vote.
records.win: The surviving party makes a correct final accusation.
records.loss: Party elimination, strict incorrect accusation, or final storm stage.

records.title: Every Hero for Themself
records.setup: Full keep, private notebooks, optional PvP, trades, bluffing, temporary alliances, and independent victory claims.
records.win: Solve first or become last independently living hero when enabled.
records.loss: Elimination or loss of accusation eligibility under strict rules.

records.title: The Keep of Eight Shadows
records.setup: Full map, increased secret passages, duplicate mirrors, elite monsters, expanded physical clues, and escalating storm/ritual stages.
records.win: Correct final accusation under the chosen playstyle.
records.loss: Configured defeat conditions for the chosen playstyle.

records.title: No Dawn for the Keep
records.setup: DCs 20–30, multiple timers, smart hostile pathing, scarce recovery, and stronger consequences without changing the sealed deduction solution.
records.win: Correct accusation before complete elimination or final doom stage.
records.loss: All eligible investigators lose or the doom clock completes.

restriction: Every scenario uses the Killer In The Keep suspect-weapon-room deduction engine and fixed hero roster.
